plan.title: 31 tasks between now and Saturday, Dec 5
plan.lede: Each task is dated, with its status and area, and setup details where you need them.

tasks.text: Lock the offer: tiers at $75 and $125, refills and gift cards excluded
tasks.detail: Set both tiers as automatic discounts in Shopify so no code is needed, and exclude the Refills and Gift cards collections. For the free tin, use a Buy X Get Y automatic discount with a $125 minimum: shoppers must add the tin to their cart, so say so on the sale page and in the launch email.

tasks.text: Decide to extend through Fri, Dec 4, and plan its sends
Confirm SPF, DKIM, and DMARC all pass for fernwoodcandle.com
tasks.detail: Check the sending domain in Privy's settings and the records in your DNS. Fix anything that fails before the first October send.

tasks.text: Swap the welcome display's 10% offer for early access, and add an SMS step
tasks.detail: Home and candle collections, new visitors, after 8 seconds, once every 3 days. Keep the thank-you page SMS signup on, with no discount. Add an SMS signup step with Privy's consent wording.

tasks.text: Update the abandoned cart flow: first email at 45 minutes, plus an SMS step
tasks.detail: Read the flow's current delays and discount first, then change only what differs.

tasks.text: Switch the welcome email and SMS to early access instead of a code
Send a re-engagement email to contacts who haven't opened in 90 days
Turn on timezone-based sending for pre-sale emails
tasks.detail: Teasers and regular emails then go out at each subscriber's local time. Sale-day sends go out on your store's clock, so shoppers everywhere hear the sale is live at the same moment.

tasks.text: Build the VIP segment: 3+ orders or $240+ lifetime spend
tasks.detail: 1,180 contacts today. Early-access signups get the same early access.

tasks.text: Build the early-access signup confirmation flow
tasks.detail: One email confirming they're on the list. The early-access link goes out as a campaign in your send calendar on the day early access opens, not from this flow.

tasks.text: Build lapsed and last-BFCM-buyer segments
tasks.detail: Lapsed: last order 90 to 365 days ago (6,310). Last BFCM buyers: first order Nov 27 to Dec 5, 2025 (3,410).

tasks.text: Write the sale emails and SMS
Schedule every sale send and preview each one
tasks.detail: Check links, the offer wording, and each send's audience before scheduling. Pick exact times a few minutes off the hour, like 9:07, to avoid the queue at the top of the hour.

tasks.text: Set up the sale discount in Shopify, scheduled with the sale
tasks.detail: Schedule it to start Nov 26 and end Dec 4. Build in the exclusions from your offer terms, then check it once it's scheduled.

tasks.text: Build the new-buyer welcome series, set to go live Dec 5
tasks.detail: First message after delivery: how to get the most from their candles. Second-purchase offer in January.

tasks.text: Build the sale page that explains the tiers and your delivery-by dates
Pause win-back and the birthday flow, and stretch review requests to 21 days
tasks.detail: Pause from Nov 24 to Dec 4 so BDAY20 can't stack with the sale. Restart both Dec 5.

tasks.text: Set Fireside Tobacco as the fallback if Cedar and Smoke runs low
Build a "Bought today" segment for the evening emails on Black Friday and Cyber Monday
tasks.detail: People who ordered in the last 24 hours. They skip the evening email on those days, after buying from the morning one.

tasks.text: Schedule a sale popup and announcement bar to run for the whole sale
tasks.detail: Show the offer and the end date. Set it to go live Nov 26 and switch back Dec 5.

tasks.text: Check the sale is set up correctly the day before launch
tasks.detail: Confirm the discount is scheduled with the right dates and exclusions, and popups and flows are set to switch on. Test each tier, a bundle, and an excluded item with a hidden code that has the same settings.

tasks.text: Open early access: SMS first, then email
Confirm sale prices are showing before the first send
tasks.detail: A quick look: sale prices on a few products and the exclusions holding. The full check happened yesterday.

tasks.text: Pause the COMEBACK15 code in the cart flow while sale pricing is live
tasks.detail: Pause it before early access opens so it can't stack on the sale. Restart it as soon as the sale ends.

tasks.text: Launch: SMS first, then email
Check complaints, bounces, unsubscribes, and SMS opt-outs after launch day's sends
tasks.detail: Spam complaints above 0.1%: stop sends to anyone not engaged in 30 days. Under 50 units of Cedar and Smoke: swap in Fireside Tobacco.

tasks.text: Check complaints, bounces, unsubscribes, and SMS opt-outs after Black Friday's sends
tasks.detail: Spam complaints above 0.1%: stop sends to anyone not engaged in 30 days. Under 50 units of Cedar and Smoke: swap in Fireside Tobacco.

tasks.text: Check complaints, bounces, unsubscribes, and SMS opt-outs after Cyber Monday's sends
tasks.detail: Spam complaints above 0.1%: stop sends to anyone not engaged in 30 days. Under 50 units of Cedar and Smoke: swap in Fireside Tobacco.

tasks.text: Send the extension email: the sale runs through Friday
Check complaints, bounces, unsubscribes, and SMS opt-outs after the final day's sends
tasks.detail: If spam complaints pass 0.1% on a send, send the rest only to your most engaged contacts.

tasks.text: Undo every sale change
tasks.detail: Turn COMEBACK15 back on in the cart flow, restart win-back, restore the welcome display's offer, and set review requests back to their usual delay. Switch the sale popup and announcement bar back to your usual signup offer. Turn on the new-buyer welcome series.

tasks.text: Book the recap for Dec 16, once returns settle
